mechanism: A discovery-surface change can be logged as a demand scenario, but it is not a replenishment forecast until authorized sales, inventory, lead-time and uncertainty inputs pass LIFD gates.

sources.claim_boundary: Confirms shopper-assistant adoption; does not establish SKU demand lift or replenishment quantities.

testable_hypotheses.change: Add an explicitly non-causal discovery-surface scenario beside the authorized baseline forecast.
testable_hypotheses.metric: forecast error, stockout exposure, excess-stock exposure
testable_hypotheses.window: at least one category-appropriate replenishment cycle
testable_hypotheses.success: scenario improves calibrated uncertainty without violating service or cash guardrails
testable_hypotheses.guardrail: no purchase order or allocation change from this signal alone
testable_hypotheses.stop: authorized demand data conflicts, uncertainty expands, or cash/service redline triggers

invalidation_conditions: authorized sales data disproves the scenario
lead-time or supply regime changes materially
